svg.title: Tower Defense · Spark (electricity) tower (#22) · Direction A: Lantern Spire
svg.text: Spark tower · Direction A: Lantern Spire
Tower Defense · art request #22 (3D-looking electricity tower, fantasy, cozy) · concept sheet, not final art
1 · Base tower at real in-game size (1x) and at 3x
Scene: one board cell beside the road (1x)
base · Storm II · Overload II, beside the road
Storm II · branch A, rust mark
Overload II · branch B, gold mark
Storm: chains to 5 (more rods, more arcs)
Overload: full damage every jump (bigger core)
Idea: a round stone-and-plaster tower with an open belfry holding a glowing spark orb under a teal cone roof; side-lit drums and cones give it volume.
Risk: tall and thin like the Arrow tower, so the two may blur at 1x; the open belfry and orb glow are what has to carry it.
"3D looking" is read as solid volumes: every drum and cone has a lit left face, a shaded right face and an elliptical top, still ink over flat paint.
